lore: A rail that wakes things up.
use: Powered by redstone, it activates minecarts, hoppers carts and TNT carts passing over it.
secret: A powered activator rail ejects the rider of a minecart.

lore: A rail that notices.
use: Gives a redstone signal while a minecart is on it.
secret: A comparator reads what is in the cart.

lore: A rail with a push in it.
use: Powered by redstone it speeds minecarts up; unpowered it brakes them.
secret: Seven powered rails are enough to keep a cart going on flat ground.

lore: Two lines that go wherever you tell them.
use: Craft iron ingots and a stick for sixteen. Place rails for minecarts to roll along.
secret: Rails connect automatically and curve at corners.

lore: Nothing, politely.
use: The empty block. It has no item in survival.
secret: Everything is built in it.

lore: A sliver of a crystal that rings.
use: Mined from amethyst clusters. Craft spyglasses, tinted glass and calibrated sensors.
secret: Amethyst blocks chime when touched or walked on, which sculk sensors can hear.

lore: The Nether's hidden treasure.
use: Mined with a diamond or netherite pickaxe. Smelt to get netherite scrap.
secret: It resists explosions, so TNT does not destroy it.

lore: A heavy friend of the careful.
use: Combines and repairs items, renames and merges enchantments. Falling on it damages the anvil and whoever stands beneath.
secret: An anvil can crush items and break blocks it falls on.

lore: A heavy friend of the careful, with some wear.
use: The anvil gets more damaged with use and eventually breaks.
secret: The more damaged it is, the closer its end.

lore: A heavy friend of the careful, with some wear.
use: The anvil gets more damaged with use and eventually breaks.
secret: The more damaged it is, the closer its end.

lore: A bite of morning.
use: Restores 4 hunger. Dropped by oak and dark oak leaves.
secret: A golden apple is an apple wrapped in gold nuggets or ingots.

lore: A plate shed by something shy.
use: Dropped by armadillos brushed with a brush. Craft wolf armor.
secret: A brush on an armadillo knocks off a scute without hurting it.

lore: A guest that never speaks.
use: Place it to display armor, tools and heads.
secret: Right-click to swap its items; it can be posed with commands.

lore: A small, fast opinion.
use: Fired from a bow or crossbow. Craft flint, a stick and a feather.
secret: Skeletons shoot arrows that can be picked up again from the ground.

lore: An arrow that shines.
use: Fired from a bow; the target glows for a time.
secret: Glowing targets show through walls.

lore: An arrow with a potion on its tip.
use: Craft arrows around a lingering potion; hits apply the potion effect.
secret: The effect is shortened to an eighth of the potion's length.

lore: A barrel that holds on to what you give it.
use: Craft planks and slabs. Stores 27 stacks and opens even with a block above.
secret: Unlike chests, barrels open under a solid block.

lore: A wall that is invisible.
use: Creative-only. Blocks movement but cannot be seen.
secret: Hold one in the hand to see them as red cubes.

lore: A column of light for those who build it right.
use: Needs a pyramid of iron, gold, emerald, diamond or netherite blocks beneath; grants area effects.
secret: The beam can be coloured by stained glass above it.

lore: Home of something that hums.
use: Found in trees. Bees live here; smoke keeps them calm when harvesting.
secret: Silk Touch moves the nest with its bees.

lore: A home the bees accept.
use: Craft planks and honeycomb. Bees return here after pollinating.
secret: A campfire below calms the bees when you harvest.

lore: A sound that carries.
use: Ring it to alert villagers; it also highlights nearby raiders.
secret: A bell shows raiders through walls.

lore: A hungry furnace for ore.
use: Smelts ores and metal gear twice as fast.
secret: Cannot cook food; that is for the smoker.

lore: A furnace that only cares about food.
use: Cooks food twice as fast.
secret: Villagers who are butchers use it as a job site.

lore: A small fire with a lot of patience.
use: Smelts ores, cooks food and burns fuel.
secret: An XP bar fills as you collect results.

lore: Fire, ground fine.
use: Craft from blaze rods; fuels brewing stands and makes eyes of ender.
secret: One powder is enough for twenty brewing steps.

lore: A staff that keeps its warmth.
use: Dropped by blazes. Used for powder and as a furnace fuel.
secret: It burns for 120 seconds, longer than coal.

lore: Ice that has lost all its manners.
use: Craft nine packed ice. Boats slide on it very quickly.
secret: It makes the best boat roads.

lore: Water, after a cold night.
use: Slippery, melts near light. Silk Touch keeps it.
secret: It turns to water when mined without Silk Touch.

lore: Ice that was pressed.
use: Craft nine ice. Slippery, and does not melt.
secret: Nine packed ice make blue ice.

lore: What is left when the rest has gone.
use: Dropped by skeletons. Craft bone meal; tame wolves with it.
secret: A wolf given a bone becomes a dog that follows you.

lore: A powder that makes things grow.
use: Use on crops, saplings and many plants to grow them.
secret: It also turns grass blocks into flowering meadows nearby.

lore: A thing that remembers more than you.
use: Craft three paper and a leather. Needed for enchanting tables, bookshelves and writable books.
secret: Books pile up as bookshelf decoration.

lore: A shelf of old opinions.
use: Craft planks and books. Place around an enchanting table for more power.
secret: Fifteen shelves around the table unlock the top level.

lore: A string and a patience.
use: Hold use to draw, release to shoot. Needs arrows.
secret: A fully drawn bow shoots further and harder.

lore: A bow with a latch.
use: Load it with an arrow or a firework, then fire. Multishot and Piercing work well on it.
secret: A loaded crossbow stays ready until used.

lore: A small hollow.
use: Craft three planks. Holds stews and soups.
secret: Right-click a mooshroom with it for stew.

lore: A twirl of wind pressed hard.
use: Dropped by breezes. Craft the mace together with a heavy core, and wind charges.
secret: One rod makes four wind charges.

lore: Wind that fits in a hand.
use: Throw it to burst; it knocks back mobs and launches you.
secret: A wind charge can open doors, buttons and trapdoors.

lore: A smash with a lot of weight.
use: Craft a heavy core and a breeze rod. Falling onto a foe multiplies the damage.
secret: Density and Breach enchantments tune it.

lore: A core made of dense metal.
use: Found in ominous vaults. Needed for the mace.
secret: It cannot be crafted.

lore: A small laboratory.
use: Craft blaze rod and cobblestone. Brews potions with blaze powder fuel.
secret: Three bottles at once, one ingredient on top.

lore: A soft way to learn something old.
use: Craft a feather, a copper ingot and a stick. Brush suspicious sand and gravel to uncover loot.
secret: It also brushes armadillos for scutes.

lore: A block that is hiding something.
use: Found in desert wells, pyramids and ocean ruins. Brush it to reveal an item.
secret: Breaking it with a pickaxe destroys the loot.

lore: A block that is hiding something.
use: Found in trail ruins and cold ocean ruins. Brush it to reveal an item.
secret: Breaking it with a pickaxe destroys the loot.

lore: A small ocean you can carry.
use: Craft three iron ingots. Fill with water, lava or milk and place it again.
secret: A cauldron takes a whole bucket.

lore: A pond that moves.
use: Place water; it flows and can stop falls.
secret: Placing it in the Nether evaporates it.

lore: A fire that flows.
use: Place lava; it burns, lights and melts. Also fuels a furnace for 100 items.
secret: A lava bucket is the longest burning fuel.

lore: Milk, for the long day.
use: Drink to clear status effects. Also crafts cakes.
secret: Milk clears all effects, good and bad.

lore: Snow that has made peace with water.
use: Place powder snow; you sink into it.
secret: Leather boots let you walk on it.

lore: A red root with a sweet streak.
use: Grown from beetroot seeds. Eat it or craft it into red dye and soup.
secret: Six beetroots and a bowl make beetroot soup.

lore: A small cap that likes the dark.
use: Grows in low light and spreads slowly. Eat in stews; plant on mycelium or in the dark.
secret: Bone meal turns it into a huge mushroom on mycelium or podzol.

lore: A small cap that likes the dark.
use: Grows in low light and spreads slowly. Eat in stews; plant on mycelium or in the dark.
secret: Bone meal turns it into a huge mushroom on mycelium or podzol.

lore: A piece of a giant mushroom.
use: Found on giant mushrooms; harvest it with an axe. Silk Touch keeps it.
secret: The caps of huge mushrooms drop small mushrooms.

lore: A piece of a giant mushroom.
use: Found on giant mushrooms; harvest it with an axe. Silk Touch keeps it.
secret: The caps of huge mushrooms drop small mushrooms.

lore: A piece of a giant mushroom.
use: Found on giant mushrooms; harvest it with an axe. Silk Touch keeps it.
secret: The caps of huge mushrooms drop small mushrooms.

lore: A pouch that stretches for one more thing.
use: Craft string and leather. Holds a mix of items up to 64 weight. Right-click to pick things up and out.
secret: A bundle cannot hold shulker boxes.

lore: A sensor that listens for one kind of sound.
use: Craft an amethyst shard on a sculk sensor. Set it with a redstone signal to react only to a chosen frequency.
secret: It can filter out vibrations you do not care about.

lore: A heartbeat in the dark.
use: Detects vibrations within 8 blocks and sends a redstone signal.
secret: Wool in front of a vibration source mutes it.

lore: A scream with a short fuse.
use: Shrieks when a player steps near; enough shrieks summon a Warden.
secret: Silk Touch keeps it.

lore: The Deep Dark's slow heart.
use: Spreads sculk when a mob dies near it.
secret: Experience from the death feeds the spread.

lore: The Deep Dark's soft carpet.
use: Found in the Deep Dark and spread by catalysts. A hoe breaks it fast.
secret: It gives experience when mined, and Silk Touch keeps it.

lore: The Deep Dark's soft carpet.
use: Found in the Deep Dark and spread by catalysts. A hoe breaks it fast.
secret: It gives experience when mined, and Silk Touch keeps it.

lore: A fire that says come sit.
use: Craft sticks, coal or charcoal and logs. Cooks food and sends smoke signals.
secret: Smoke rises further with a hay bale below.

lore: A fire the colour of memory.
use: Craft with soul sand or soil. Cooks food and deals double damage to anything that walks in it.
secret: Piglins fear soul fire.

lore: A small stub of light that likes company.
use: Craft string and honeycomb. Light with flint and steel; up to four on one block.
secret: Place a cake and put a candle on it for a birthday.

lore: A plain root that ends up everywhere.
use: Grown from a carrot. Eat it or feed pigs.
secret: A golden carrot is a carrot wrapped in gold nuggets.

lore: A carrot that wants to be remembered.
use: Restores much hunger and saturation. Used to brew night vision.
secret: It also breeds horses.

lore: An apple that thinks it is a king.
use: Gives Regeneration and Absorption. Craft an apple with eight gold ingots.
secret: Cure a zombie villager with it and a weakness potion.

lore: An apple with too much glow.
use: Cannot be crafted. Gives strong Regeneration, Absorption, Resistance and Fire Resistance.
secret: Found rarely in treasure chests.

lore: A joke that works.
use: Craft a fishing rod and a carrot. Use it to steer a saddled pig.
secret: The carrot loses durability as the pig moves.

lore: A fungus that strider cannot resist.
use: Craft a fishing rod and a warped fungus. Steers a saddled strider.
secret: The strider speeds up when it is held.

lore: A table for those who want to see everything.
use: Craft paper and planks. Copy, zoom and lock maps.
secret: Cartographer villagers use it.

lore: A pumpkin with a view.
use: Craft with shears. Wear it, and endermen can be looked at safely.
secret: It builds snow and iron golems.

lore: A pumpkin that kept a candle.
use: Craft a carved pumpkin and a torch. Gives light.
secret: Golems can also be built from it.

lore: A big round guest.
use: Grown from seeds; shear it to carve it. Craft pumpkin pie.
secret: Pumpkins and melons need an adjacent block to grow fruit.

lore: A cool slice of summer.
use: Craft melon slices into a block; breaking it gives slices.
secret: Fortune gives more slices.

lore: A bite of sweetness.
use: Eat for hunger; a glistering slice is brewed into healing potions.
secret: Gold nuggets turn slices into glistering ones.

lore: A bite of sweetness.
use: Eat for hunger; a glistering slice is brewed into healing potions.
secret: Gold nuggets turn slices into glistering ones.

lore: A pot for brewing patience.
use: Craft seven iron ingots. Holds water, lava or powder snow; washes banners and armor.
secret: Rain fills it, and dripstone drips lava into it.

lore: What the log remembers of fire.
use: Smelt logs. Burns as a fuel; used for torches.
secret: Charcoal cooks eight items.

lore: A black stone that remembers light.
use: Mined from coal ore. Fuel for furnaces and torches.
secret: Coal burns for 80 seconds.

lore: The oldest answer to 'where did I put it'.
use: Craft eight planks. Stores 27 stacks; two side by side make a double chest.
secret: A cat sitting on it blocks it from opening.

lore: A chest with a nasty surprise.
use: Craft a chest and a tripwire hook. Emits a redstone signal when opened.
secret: The signal grows with the number of viewers.

lore: A chest with a door to another place.
use: Craft eight obsidian and an eye of ender. Shared by all your ender chests.
secret: Silk Touch keeps the chest; the items remain safe.

lore: A plant that grows toward the sky of the End.
use: Grows on end stone in the End's outer islands; break it to harvest chorus fruit.
secret: A chorus flower grows only while its stalk is not blocked.

lore: A plant that grows toward the sky of the End.
use: Grows on end stone in the End's outer islands; break it to harvest chorus fruit.
secret: A chorus flower grows only while its stalk is not blocked.

lore: A fruit that moves you.
use: Eating teleports you a short distance, and can be eaten even when you are full. Smelt it for popped chorus fruit, which crafts purpur.
secret: Eating it unpredictably can drop you into water or a cave.

lore: A fruit that burst in the fire.
use: Smelt chorus fruit. Craft purpur blocks from it.
secret: It is not edible.

lore: A small lump of earth.
use: Dropped by clay; craft bricks and clay blocks.
secret: Four balls make a clay block.

lore: A circle that knows when.
use: Craft gold ingots and redstone. Shows the time of day.
secret: In the Nether and End it spins at random.

lore: A needle with a home.
use: Craft iron ingots and redstone. Points to the world spawn.
secret: In the Nether and End it spins at random.

lore: A needle that points to where it ended.
use: Craft echo shards and a compass. Points to your last death.
secret: It works in any dimension.

lore: A rock with a will to be found.
use: Craft netherite ingot and chiseled stone bricks. Link a compass to it by using it.
secret: The compass points to it in every dimension.

lore: A strand left by something eight-legged.
use: Shears or swords harvest it. Slows anything that passes through.
secret: A sword cuts it fastest.

lore: A seed from the jungle's gloom.
use: Plant on jungle logs. Craft cookies and brown dye.
secret: Eat them in a cookie, not on their own.

lore: A redstone brain that compares.
use: Craft redstone torches, quartz and stone. Measures container contents and compares signals.
secret: It subtracts when put in subtract mode.

lore: A signal that needs a push.
use: Craft redstone torches, redstone and stone. Extends a signal and adds a delay.
secret: Right-click to set the delay between one and four ticks.

lore: A block that stares until something changes.
use: Gives a short pulse when the block in front of it changes.
secret: It watches crops, pistons and lots more.

lore: A block with a shove in it.
use: Pushes up to 12 blocks when powered; the sticky one pulls them back.
secret: Obsidian and bedrock cannot be moved.

lore: A block with a shove in it.
use: Pushes up to 12 blocks when powered; the sticky one pulls them back.
secret: Obsidian and bedrock cannot be moved.

lore: A dust that carries thought.
use: Mined from redstone ore. Carries signals; crafts repeaters, comparators and more.
secret: A line of 15 dust loses its signal.

lore: A torch that inverts.
use: Turns off when the block it is attached to is powered.
secret: It powers adjacent dust and the block above it.

lore: A lamp that obeys.
use: Craft redstone and glowstone. Lights when powered.
secret: Once lit it stays lit a moment after power is gone.

lore: A plate that counts.
use: Gives a stronger signal the more items sit on it.
secret: Heavy takes more items to reach full strength.

lore: A plate that counts.
use: Gives a stronger signal the more items sit on it.
secret: Heavy takes more items to reach full strength.

lore: A switch for those who like clicks.
use: Craft a stick and cobblestone. Toggles a redstone signal.
secret: It can be placed on any side of a block.

lore: A hook that sets a trap.
use: Place two with string between them. Triggers when something crosses the line.
secret: Shears cut a string safely.

lore: A block that gives and fires.
use: Craft with a bow. Fires arrows, places buckets, equips armor and more when powered.
secret: Dispensers can shear sheep too.

lore: A block that lets go.
use: Drops one item out of its front when powered.
secret: It feeds hoppers and chests below.

lore: A funnel that never lets go.
use: Craft iron ingots and a chest. Moves items between containers.
secret: A powered hopper stops moving.

lore: A table that works for you.
use: Craft iron, redstone, a crafting table and a dropper. Crafts when powered.
secret: Tap a slot to disable it.

lore: A table of small wonders.
use: Craft four planks. A 3x3 grid for recipes.
secret: Carpenter villagers use it as a job site.

lore: A table where metal learns new forms.
use: Craft iron ingots and planks. Upgrades gear to netherite and adds armor trims.
secret: Toolsmith villagers use it as a job site.

lore: A saw that never tires.
use: Craft iron and stone. Cuts stone blocks into stairs, slabs and more, one to one.
secret: Mason villagers use it.

lore: A wheel that forgets.
use: Craft a stick, slabs and planks. Removes enchantments from items and gives some experience.
secret: It repairs tools by combining two.

lore: A frame for the colours.
use: Craft string and planks. Applies patterns to banners.
secret: Shepherd villagers use it.

lore: A bench for arrows.
use: Craft flint and planks. Villagers who are fletchers use it.
secret: It has no use for players but is a job site.

lore: A stand for a single book.
use: Craft slabs and a bookshelf. Holds a book and can emit signals as you page.
secret: Librarian villagers use it.

lore: A bin that turns scraps into soil.
use: Craft planks. Fill with plants; it makes bone meal.
secret: Farmer villagers use it.

lore: A heart that makes the sea breathe.
use: Craft nautilus shells and a heart of the sea. Gives water breathing and underwater mining speed in a prismarine frame.
secret: It attacks hostile mobs nearby.

lore: A prize from the deep.
use: Found in buried treasure. Craft a conduit.
secret: Buried treasure maps lead you there.

lore: A spiral of the sea.
use: Dropped by drowned. Craft a conduit.
secret: Drowned with tridents may drop a trident too.

lore: A spear that returns.
use: Found from drowned. Throw it; with Loyalty it comes back.
secret: Riptide pulls you through water or rain.

lore: The pulse of something that waits.
use: Found in Pale Garden trees. Breaking it yields resin.
secret: Creaking heartwood only works at night.

lore: A stick that knows block states.
use: Creative-only. Use it on blocks to cycle and read their properties.
secret: Sneak and use to change which property you edit.

lore: A pot with a story on each side.
use: Craft four bricks or sherds. Stores one stack; shows its sherd pictures.
secret: Break it with a pickaxe to keep the pot, and it drops its sherds.

lore: A piece of a song not finished.
use: Found in ancient cities. Nine make the disc 5.
secret: The disc 5 is made of nine fragments.

lore: A hard, clear promise.
use: Mined from diamond ore. Crafts tools, armor and blocks.
secret: Fortune gives more diamonds.

lore: The currency of villagers.
use: Mined from emerald ore or traded. Buys goods from villagers.
secret: Mountain biomes hold the ore.

lore: A blue stone for those who want results.
use: Mined from lapis ore. Used for enchanting and blue dye.
secret: Place it in the enchanting table slot to pay for enchants.

lore: Fire that flows as a mist.
use: Collect with a glass bottle from the dragon's breath cloud. Brews lingering potions.
secret: A bottle in the cloud is the only way to get it.

lore: A prize the dragon leaves.
use: Appears at the portal after the first dragon dies. Teleports when clicked.
secret: It falls like sand when its support is removed.

lore: A ghast, after a long dry spell.
use: Place it and keep it near water to grow it into a ghastling.
secret: A dried ghast block takes water to hatch.

lore: A snack that never rots.
use: Smelt kelp. Eat quickly.
secret: Nine dried kelp make a block.

lore: A sliver of silence from the Deep Dark.
use: Found in ancient city chests. Craft recovery compasses and calibrated sensors.
secret: Eight echo shards around a compass make a recovery compass.

lore: Wings, for those who dare.
use: Found in End ships. Fly by jumping and activating in air.
secret: Repair with phantom membranes.

lore: A book that was taught something.
use: Found in loot or made at an enchanting table. Combine at an anvil to apply.
secret: Villagers sell them with random enchantments.

lore: A table that listens to the stars.
use: Craft diamonds, obsidian and a book. Spend lapis and levels to enchant items.
secret: Bookshelves around it raise its power.

lore: A heart that heals the dragon.
use: Craft glass, eye of ender and ghast tear. Placed on obsidian or bedrock; explodes when hit.
secret: Four of them on the portal frame bring the dragon back.

lore: A frame for a doorway.
use: Found in strongholds. Fill with eyes of ender to open the End portal.
secret: A comparator reads whether it has an eye.

lore: A lamp from the End.
use: Craft a blaze rod and popped chorus fruit. Gives light and turns toward the side.
secret: Light shows in the End as white.

lore: An eye that looks for home.
use: Craft ender pearl and blaze powder. Thrown, it flies toward the nearest stronghold.
secret: It breaks half the time.

lore: A thrown thought.
use: Dropped by endermen. Teleports you to where it lands, for 5 points of damage.
secret: Looting gives more pearls.

lore: A bottle of enough.
use: Thrown, it releases experience orbs. Found in loot or trades.
secret: It gives between three and eleven points.

lore: A light touch.
use: Dropped by chickens. Craft arrows and brushes.
secret: Looting gives more feathers.

lore: A spider eye that learned to rot properly.
use: Craft spider eye, sugar and a brown mushroom. Brews weakness and harming potions.
secret: It turns good potions into their bad opposites.

lore: A fireball that stays still.
use: Craft blaze powder, coal and gunpowder. Throw or place to start fires.
secret: Dispensers fire it as a small fireball.

lore: A small festival.
use: Craft paper, gunpowder and optional stars. Fireworks launch you with elytra.
secret: Each gunpowder adds flight duration.

lore: A single colour, waiting to explode.
use: Craft gunpowder and dye. Add effects with extra items.
secret: Gold nuggets make a star shape.

lore: A string and a patient mind.
use: Craft sticks and string. Cast and reel to catch fish, treasure and junk.
secret: Lure speeds up bites.

lore: A sharp edge from the gravel.
use: Dropped from gravel. Craft arrows and flint and steel.
secret: Gravel drops flint more often with Fortune.

lore: A spark you can carry.
use: Craft an iron ingot and flint. Lights fires, portals, TNT and candles.
secret: Creepers explode when you light them.

lore: A little garden.
use: Craft three bricks. Holds a flower or sapling.
secret: A pot can hold many plants, not only flowers.

lore: Eggs of a pond.
use: Laid by frogs. Place on water; tadpoles hatch.
secret: Tadpoles grow into frogs whose colour depends on the biome they grew up in.

lore: A cry in a bottle.
use: Dropped by ghasts. Brews regeneration potions and end crystals.
secret: Ghasts drop it when killed with their own fireball.

lore: A dark stone with gold in it.
use: Found in bastions. Drops gold nuggets when mined.
secret: Piglins guard bastions.

lore: A window made of sand.
use: Smelt sand. Transparent and does not drop itself.
secret: Silk Touch keeps it.

lore: A thin window.
use: Craft six glass for sixteen. Connects to neighbours.
secret: Silk Touch keeps it.

lore: A small glass cup for what's inside.
use: Craft three glass. Fill with water, honey or dragon's breath.
secret: Right-click a beehive for honey.

lore: Berries with their own light.
use: Found on cave vines. Eat for hunger; they glow in the dark.
secret: Use bone meal on vines to grow more.

lore: Ink that shines.
use: Dropped by glow squids. Dyes signs to glow.
secret: Applying it to a sign makes the text glow.

lore: A squid's final word.
use: Dropped by squids. Black dye.
secret: Combine with bone meal for gray.

lore: Light from the Nether's ceiling.
use: Craft four glowstone dust. Gives full light.
secret: Mining it gives two to four dust.

lore: A sparkle that's easy to pour.
use: Dropped from glowstone. Crafts redstone lamps and potions.
secret: Brewing it extends potency.

lore: A call that carries.
use: Dropped when a goat rams a hard block. Use to blow it.
secret: Each horn has a different tune.

lore: A dust that holds a bang.
use: Dropped by creepers. Crafts TNT and fireworks.
secret: Brewing it makes splash potions.

lore: Four sand, five gunpowder, one bad idea.
use: Lit with flint and steel or redstone; explodes after a short fuse.
secret: Water prevents block damage from the blast.

lore: Sweetness in a glass.
use: Collected from a beehive with a bottle. Drinking removes poison.
secret: Four bottles make a honey block.

lore: A wax and a sweetness.
use: Harvested with shears from beehives. Waxes copper and signs.
secret: Four combs make a honeycomb block.

lore: A window with a grudge.
use: Craft six iron ingots. Connects to neighbours; mobs cannot pass.
secret: Villagers in a jail stay put behind them.

lore: A chain made of iron.
use: Craft iron ingots and nuggets. Hangs lanterns or bells and can be climbed.
secret: Chains also connect to blocks horizontally.

lore: A picture of a thing.
use: Craft sticks and leather. Shows an item on a wall; rotate by right-clicking.
secret: A comparator reads its rotation.

lore: A picture of a thing that shines.
use: Craft an item frame and a glow ink sac. Item stays visible in the dark.
secret: The frame itself does not light up.

lore: A window to a memory.
use: Craft sticks and wool. Right-click a wall to hang one of many motifs.
secret: Larger spaces choose larger paintings.

lore: A box with a record collection.
use: Craft diamond and planks. Plays music discs.
secret: Each disc plays once until it ends.

lore: A block that knows a note.
use: Craft redstone and planks. Click to change the pitch; the block below sets the instrument.
secret: Heads on top play mob sounds.

lore: A book that teaches recipes.
use: Cannot be crafted. Use it to unlock recipes.
secret: It is a tool for creative worlds and tests.

lore: A way up that asks nothing.
use: Craft sticks. Climb it.
secret: Sneak to hold on without moving.

lore: A candle that learned to hang.
use: Craft iron nuggets and a torch. Gives steady light.
secret: Soul lanterns glow blue.

lore: A lantern with a quiet blue fire.
use: Craft iron nuggets and a soul torch. Gives light level 10.
secret: Piglins dislike soul fire.

lore: A small flame with a stick.
use: Craft coal and a stick. Gives light level 14.
secret: Water extinguishes it.

lore: A torch with a blue flame.
use: Craft coal and soul sand or soil. Gives light level 10.
secret: Piglins dislike soul fire.

lore: Skin, tanned.
use: Dropped by cows, horses and others. Crafts armor, books and bundles.
secret: Rabbit hide crafts into leather too.

lore: A small scrap of fur.
use: Dropped by rabbits. Four make leather.
secret: The foot is rarer.

lore: A lucky charm, they say.
use: Dropped rarely by rabbits. Brews jumping potions.
secret: Looting raises the chance.

lore: A rope that keeps friends close.
use: Craft strings and a slimeball. Leash animals to fences.
secret: A leashed mob follows you.

lore: A bouncy blob.
use: Dropped by slimes. Crafts leads, sticky pistons and slime blocks.
secret: Nine make a slime block.

lore: A hot paste.
use: Dropped by magma cubes. Brews fire resistance.
secret: Craft with blaze powder and a slimeball.

lore: A paper that shows where you've been.
use: Craft paper around a compass. Explores as you walk, and can be enlarged.
secret: A cartography table copies it.

lore: A word that sticks.
use: Found in loot. Name a mob at an anvil, then use it.
secret: A named mob does not despawn.

lore: A star that fell in the Nether.
use: Dropped by the Wither. Crafts beacons.
secret: It cannot be destroyed by explosions.

lore: A fungus that likes warm soil.
use: Found in Nether fortresses. Plant on soul sand; brews awkward potions.
secret: Fortune adds more.

lore: A fragment of the Nether's heart.
use: Smelt ancient debris. Four scrap and four gold ingots craft a netherite ingot.
secret: Scrap floats in lava like all netherite.

lore: A pattern for a long road.
use: Found in bastions. Upgrades diamond gear to netherite at a smithing table.
secret: Craft seven diamonds, netherrack and a template for two.

lore: A bottle that tastes of omens.
use: Dropped by raid captains. Drink to get Bad Omen.
secret: A stronger omen means a stronger raid.

lore: A key that feels heavy.
use: Dropped by ominous trial spawners. Opens ominous vaults.
secret: The loot is better.

lore: A key that was earned.
use: Dropped by trial spawners. Opens vaults.
secret: Each player may use a vault once per key.

lore: A box that rewards the brave.
use: Found in trial chambers. Opens with a key and gives loot.
secret: Each player gets a reward only once.

lore: A cage of trials.
use: Found in trial chambers. Spawns waves of mobs while players are near.
secret: When beaten it ejects rewards and a key.

lore: A cage that refills.
use: Found in dungeons and fortresses. Spawns mobs of one type while a player is near.
secret: A spawn egg used on it changes the mob.

lore: A page without words.
use: Craft three sugar canes. Crafts books, maps and fireworks.
secret: Three canes make three sheets.

lore: A thin skin of the night.
use: Dropped by phantoms. Repairs elytra and brews slow falling.
secret: Phantoms appear after sleepless nights.

lore: A bottle of effects.
use: Brewed from water, nether wart and ingredients. Drink for its effect.
secret: Splash and lingering forms spread it.

lore: A potion that throws well.
use: Add gunpowder to a potion. Throw to affect mobs nearby.
secret: Closer targets get stronger effects.

lore: A potion that stays.
use: Add dragon's breath to a splash potion. Leaves a cloud of its effect.
secret: Fill arrows with it.

lore: A crystal that shines under water.
use: Dropped by guardians. Crafts sea lanterns.
secret: Elder guardians drop more.

lore: A splinter of the deep.
use: Dropped by guardians. Crafts prismarine.
secret: Four make prismarine.

lore: A lantern the ocean built.
use: Craft prismarine crystals and shards. Gives full light.
secret: Found in ocean monuments.

lore: A seat for something that runs.
use: Found in loot. Ride a horse, pig or strider once tamed.
secret: A saddle is needed to steer.

lore: A temporary climb.
use: Craft bamboo and string. Climb up and down; stack it.
secret: Break the bottom and it all falls.

lore: Two blades that agree.
use: Craft two iron ingots. Cuts wool, leaves, vines and cobwebs.
secret: Dispensers shear sheep too.

lore: A wall you carry.
use: Craft planks and an iron ingot. Raise to block attacks.
secret: Banners can be applied.

lore: A box with a bad temper and a good memory.
use: Craft two shulker shells and a chest. Mining it keeps its contents.
secret: It cannot go inside another.

lore: A shell that closes.
use: Dropped by shulkers. Crafts shulker boxes.
secret: Shulkers appear in End cities.

lore: A thin blanket.
use: Layers stack; a shovel collects snowballs.
secret: Eight layers fill a block.

lore: A block of cold.
use: Craft four snowballs. Used in building and for snow golems.
secret: Snow golems leave a trail of snow.

lore: A small cold throw.
use: Throw it for knockback. Craft snow blocks.
secret: Blazes take damage from it.

lore: Ground that holds a memory.
use: Found in the Nether's valleys. Soul sand slows walkers; place soul fire on both.
secret: Nether wart grows on soul sand.

lore: Ground that holds a memory.
use: Found in the Nether's valleys. Soul sand slows walkers; place soul fire on both.
secret: Nether wart grows on soul sand.

lore: A block that drinks.
use: Found in ocean monuments. Soaks up nearby water.
secret: Dry it in a furnace to reuse.

lore: A sponge, full.
use: Soaked sponge. Smelt to dry.
secret: Place it in the Nether to dry it.

lore: An eye that goes far.
use: Craft copper and an amethyst shard. Use to zoom.
secret: Zooming in shows distant mobs.

lore: A small piece of tree.
use: Craft two planks. Crafts tools and many things.
secret: A stick burns briefly.

lore: A thread of the web.
use: Dropped by spiders. Crafts bows, fishing rods and wool.
secret: Four make a wool block.

lore: A sweet sprinkle.
use: Craft sugar cane. Used in cakes, potions and pies.
secret: Honey bottles yield sugar too.

lore: A tart bush treat.
use: Found in taigas. Eat for hunger; plant to grow bushes.
secret: The bush hurts anything that touches it.

lore: A block that scores.
use: Craft redstone and hay. Gives a signal depending on how close the hit.
secret: A bull's-eye gives the strongest signal.

lore: A glass that blocks the light.
use: Craft amethyst shards and glass. Lets no light through.
secret: Sculk sensors hear through it.

lore: A figure that cheats death.
use: Dropped by evokers. Hold in hand to survive one lethal hit.
secret: Consumed when it saves you.

lore: A promise on the beach.
use: Place on sand. Hatches into turtles; zombies and others trample it.
secret: It hatches faster at night.

lore: A big, warm thing.
use: Found by sniffing. Place on moss; it hatches into a sniffling.
secret: Moss speeds it up.

lore: A plate of a growing turtle.
use: Dropped when a baby turtle grows up. Crafts turtle helmets.
secret: Turtle helmets give water breathing.

lore: A shell you wear.
use: Craft five turtle scutes. Gives a few seconds of water breathing after you enter water.
secret: Repair it with scutes.

lore: A coat for a pack member.
use: Craft armadillo scutes. Right-click a tamed wolf to equip.
secret: It protects the wolf and cracks when damaged.

lore: A golden promise.
use: Grown from seeds. Crafts bread and feeds animals.
secret: Three make bread.

lore: A tuber with ambition.
use: Plant it on farmland. Eat it baked for more hunger.
secret: A baked potato restores far more than a raw one.

lore: A book that waits for a pen.
use: Craft book, ink sac and feather. Write pages.
secret: Sign it to make a written book.

lore: A book that said its piece.
use: Sign a writable book. Cannot be edited again.
secret: Copy it by combining with a book.

lore: A tool for building worlds.
use: Creative-only. Saves and loads structures.
secret: Operators can set its size, offset and mode.

lore: A block for those who build the builders' tools.
use: Creative-only. Used for structure files and tests.
secret: It cannot be obtained in survival.

lore: A block for those who build the builders' tools.
use: Creative-only. Used for structure files and tests.
secret: It cannot be obtained in survival.

lore: A block for those who build the builders' tools.
use: Creative-only. Used for structure files and tests.
secret: It cannot be obtained in survival.

lore: A block for those who build the builders' tools.
use: Creative-only. Used for structure files and tests.
secret: It cannot be obtained in survival.

lore: A block for those who build the builders' tools.
use: Creative-only. Used for structure files and tests.
secret: It cannot be obtained in survival.

lore: A spawn point for the Nether.
use: Craft crying obsidian and glowstone. Charge with glowstone; sets spawn there.
secret: It explodes in the Overworld.

lore: A bed of straw, humble and warm.
use: A simple bed. Place and sleep to skip the night and set your spawn.
secret: Beds explode in the Nether and the End.

lore: A panel that watches the sky.
use: Craft glass, quartz and wooden slabs. Gives a redstone signal that follows the sun; right-click to invert.
secret: It also works at night inverted.

lore: A bracket on a trunk.
use: A mushroom that grows on logs. Harvested with a hand or an axe.
secret: It grows on wood.

lore: A paper that shows where you've been.
use: Made when you use an empty map; it fills in as you explore.
secret: Enlarge it at a cartography table, or lock it to keep it as it is.

lore: {name}: a shell with something very patient inside.
use: Right-click a block to spawn the mob; use it on a spawner to change what that spawner spawns. Creative-only in normal play.
secret: Use it on a baby-friendly mob of the same kind and a baby appears instead of a grown one.

lore: {name}: a round of black wax that remembers a whole room.
use: Put it in a jukebox to hear it; a comparator next to the jukebox reads whether a disc plays. Found in chests, or from a skeleton killed by a creeper.
secret: Notes and particles rise above a playing jukebox, and nearby allays dance to it.

lore: {name}: a pattern pressed into stone for those who dress for the occasion.
use: Smithing table: template, an armor piece and a trim material (ingot, gem or dust) add this trim. The template is used up; copy it with seven diamonds and the block it is made of.
secret: Same template, any armor, any material: only the combination of pattern and colour makes each look.

lore: {name}: a broken piece of a forgotten household.
use: Found by brushing suspicious sand in desert wells and pyramids, warm ocean ruins and trail ruins. Four sherds or bricks in a diamond make a decorated pot.
secret: Each side of a decorated pot can show a different sherd.

lore: {name}: a motif waiting for a banner to carry it.
use: Use it in a loom with a banner and dye to add the pattern.
secret: A banner can hold up to six patterns.

lore: {name}: colour pressed into a small powder.
use: Dyes wool, carpets, beds, banners, terracotta, glass, candles, shulker boxes, leather armor, sheep and collars, and mixes into new colours in the crafting grid.
secret: Fireworks use dyes too: a firework star takes its colours from them.

lore: {name}: soft, cheerful and a little flammable.
use: Sheared from sheep or crafted from four strings. Dyeable. Wool can be burnt, but it dampens vibrations: sculk sensors do not hear steps and blocks placed on it.
secret: Wool silences vibrations; a layer under a redstone build or around a sensor makes the area quiet.

lore: {name}: a thin skin of colour over the floor.
use: Craft two wool of the same colour for three carpets. Only a sixteenth of a block thick; llamas wear it as a decoration.
secret: Carpets muffle vibrations just like wool, so sculk sensors do not hear steps on them.

lore: {name}: a hard, flat colour that does not try to be anything else.
use: Made by pouring water on concrete powder of the same colour. Smooth, sturdy and very uniform.
secret: It cannot be dyed back; the colour is fixed once the powder meets water.

lore: {name}: dust that falls like sand and sets like stone.
use: Craft sand, gravel and dye. It falls like sand and turns into concrete when touched by water.
secret: Place it beside water, or let it fall into a pool: a cheap way to build coloured walls.

lore: {name}: clay that was dyed before it was fired.
use: Craft eight terracotta around one dye. Used in building and for bright, matte walls. Also found as natural bands in badlands.
secret: Smelt it again to get glazed terracotta, which has its own patterns.

lore: {name}: a patterned tile with a mind of its own.
use: Smelt terracotta of the same colour. Its pattern faces the direction it was placed, so four tiles in a square can join into one picture.
secret: Pistons can push glazed terracotta, but sticky pistons cannot pull it back.

lore: {name}: a window that learned a colour.
use: Craft eight glass around one dye. Transparent, tints the light and does not drop itself unless mined with Silk Touch.
secret: Beacon beams passing through it take on its colour.

lore: {name}: a thin colour, held at the edges.
use: Craft six stained glass in two rows for sixteen panes. Connects to neighbours like an iron bar.
secret: Several panes side by side make stained windows with thin frames.

lore: {name}: a flag for anyone who wants to be known.
use: Craft six wool and a stick. Add patterns at a loom with dye, and carry them on a shield.
secret: Use a map on a placed banner to mark the spot on that map with a coloured pin.

lore: {name}: a place where the night does not count.
use: Craft three wool over three planks. Sleep through the night and set your spawn point; in the Nether and the End it explodes.
secret: Beds can be used to skip the night only when the others in the world are asleep too, in multiplayer.

lore: {name}: a small stub of light that likes company.
use: Craft string and honeycomb, then dye it. Light with flint and steel; up to four on one block, each adding more light.
secret: Place a cake and put a candle on it for a birthday.

lore: {name}: a box with a bad temper and a good memory.
use: Craft two shulker shells with a chest. Mining it keeps its contents, so you can carry 27 stacks.
secret: A shulker box cannot be put inside another one.

lore: {name}: a pouch that stretches for one more thing.
use: Craft a string and leather, then dye it. Holds a mix of items up to 64 weight. Right-click to pick things up and out.
secret: A bundle cannot hold shulker boxes.

lore: {name}: a harness for a friend that floats.
use: Put it on a Happy Ghast so players can ride it, up to four at a time.
secret: The harness colour shows on the ghast while it floats.

lore: {name}: a soft seat that insists on staying put.
use: A decorative cushion in this colour. Place it on a chair, a bench or the floor.
secret: Cushions come in all sixteen dye colours.

lore: {name}: the body of a tree, ready to become anything.
use: Chop with an axe for planks; use an axe on it to strip the bark. Burns in a furnace and makes charcoal. Nether stems do not burn.
secret: The wood and hyphae variants show the bark on all six sides.

lore: {name}: wood that has found its shape.
use: Made from logs. The basis of crafting tables, tools, doors, fences and furniture. Overworld wood burns; Nether wood does not.
secret: Planks of different kinds do not mix in recipes that want a specific wood.

lore: {name}: a gate that is never quite closed.
use: A door for fences. Opens with a click or a redstone signal and can be placed anywhere along a wall.
secret: Animals will not walk through a closed gate, which makes it a farm essential.

lore: {name}: a rail that says no politely.
use: Connects to blocks and other fences. Prevents walking over; players and mobs cannot step over it because it is 1.5 blocks high.
secret: A lead can be tied to a fence post to hold an animal.

lore: {name}: it stands for what lies behind it.
use: Opens with a click or a redstone signal. Wooden doors can be opened by hand; iron doors only with redstone.
secret: Two doors side by side with opposite hinges open together as a double door.

lore: {name}: a door that lies down.
use: Opens like a door onto a floor or a wall. Use it as a hatch, a table or a shelf.
secret: A trapdoor placed on a ladder lets you close a shaft.

lore: {name}: words that hang by a chain.
use: Place it under a block or beam and write on both sides. Can be waxed with honeycomb and dyed.
secret: A hanging sign can be glowed with a glow ink sac.

lore: {name}: a board that tells you what to think.
use: Place on a block and write four lines on each side. Dye it with a dye; wax it to lock the text.
secret: A glow ink sac makes the letters glow in the dark.

lore: {name}: a small push that carries a signal.
use: Gives a short redstone pulse when pressed; wooden ones last 1.5 seconds, stone ones 1 second. Arrows also press wooden buttons.
secret: Place it on any side of a block, including a ceiling.

lore: {name}: it knows when someone has arrived.
use: Gives a signal as long as something stands on it. Wooden plates react to any entity, stone plates only to mobs and players.
secret: Items dropped on a wooden plate also trigger it.

lore: {name}: a hull for wanderers.
use: Place it on water and right-click to ride. Chest versions have 27 slots; bamboo makes rafts.
secret: Boats travel much faster on ice.

lore: {name}: a plank with room for three things.
use: A wall-mounted shelf that holds up to three items.
secret: A redstone signal makes the shelf swap its items with your hotbar.

lore: {name}: a green crown, full of small things.
use: Drops saplings, sticks and sometimes apples when broken, more with shears. Shears or Silk Touch keep the block.
secret: Leaves decay once no log is within six blocks of them.

lore: {name}: a promise that will take a while.
use: Plant it on grass or dirt with space above. It grows into a tree when the light is high enough. Bone meal speeds it up.
secret: Four saplings in a 2x2 square can grow a giant tree for some species; dark oak needs it.

lore: {name}: a step, then another, then a view.
use: Craft six blocks into four stairs. Walk up without jumping; place them upside down for ceilings and arches.
secret: A stonecutter makes one stair per block, which is cheaper than the crafting grid.

lore: {name}: half a block, whole usefulness.
use: Craft three blocks into six slabs. Two slabs of the same kind stack into a full block.
secret: Slabs let you climb without jumping and make delicate terraces.

lore: {name}: a barrier built to look old.
use: Craft six blocks into six walls. Connects to blocks and other walls; too tall to jump.
secret: Walls grow a post where they meet in a corner or when something sits on them.

lore: {name}: a sharp opinion.
use: Its material sets damage and durability. A fully charged swing also sweeps nearby foes. Enchant it at a table or anvil.
secret: Of all tools a sword cuts cobwebs the fastest.

lore: {name}: it asks stone to move aside.
use: Mines stone, ores and metal blocks. The material decides which ores it can harvest and how fast.
secret: Without a pickaxe of the right tier, ores break but drop nothing.

lore: {name}: it knows what a tree is thinking.
use: Chops wood quickly, strips logs and scrapes copper. Hits harder than a sword, but slower.
secret: A hit with an axe can disable a shield for a few seconds.

lore: {name}: it makes holes, and sometimes paths.
use: Digs dirt, sand, gravel and snow quickly. Right-click grass to flatten it into a path.
secret: Shovels also extinguish campfires.

lore: {name}: a farmer's whisper to the soil.
use: Turns dirt and grass into farmland, and breaks leaves, hay bales, moss and sculk quickly.
secret: The hoe is the right tool for sculk, moss, hay and leaves, not only for soil.

lore: {name}: the long way of saying hello.
use: A spear: jab at foes from a little farther away than a sword. Its material sets damage and durability.
secret: Enchant it at a table or anvil like other weapons.

lore: {name}: a soft shell for the small hours.
use: Wear it for protection; each piece adds armor. It can be dyed and keeps you warm in powder snow.
secret: Leather armor is the only armor that can be dyed in a cauldron or the crafting grid.

lore: {name}: rings that add up to a plan.
use: Wear it for protection; each piece adds armor. Not craftable in the usual way; found from mobs and loot.
secret: It protects about as much as iron, but with a better enchantment value.

lore: {name}: the dependable default.
use: Wear it for protection; each piece adds armor. Smelt ingots and craft pieces. Repair with iron ingots on an anvil.
secret: Iron is the first tier worth enchanting at a table.

lore: {name}: it shines, which is the point.
use: Wear it for protection; each piece adds armor. It protects less than iron, but piglins do not attack a wearer in gold.
secret: Wear one gold piece and piglins stay calm; it is the best bribe in the Nether.

lore: {name}: a blue edge for the brave.
use: Wear it for protection; each piece adds armor. High protection with a good enchantment value; repair with diamonds.
secret: Diamond armor can be upgraded to netherite at a smithing table.

lore: {name}: it was forged where nothing else survives.
use: Wear it for protection; each piece adds armor. Upgrade diamond armor at a smithing table. Highest protection and toughness; does not burn and resists knockback.
secret: Dropped netherite items float in lava and do not burn.

lore: {name}: a green shine that ages with you.
use: Wear it for protection; each piece adds armor. Craft from copper ingots; repair with copper ingots. A cheap step up from leather.
secret: Wear it in the rain for the look; the metal itself protects like cheap iron.

lore: {name}: a coat for a loyal runner.
use: Right-click a horse to dress it. Better material gives more protection.
secret: Dispensers can also put it on a horse.

lore: {name}: a shell for a creature of the deep.
use: Right-click a tamed nautilus to put it on. Better material gives more protection.
secret: Dispensers can equip it on a nautilus too.

lore: {name}: it wants the sky's attention.
use: Redirects lightning within a wide radius to itself and sends a redstone pulse. Protects wooden builds from fire.
secret: Oxidation stage and wax change only the colour; the rod still catches lightning.

lore: {name}: kept at the age it was waxed.
use: Apply honeycomb to stop the oxidation. An axe scrapes the wax off again.
secret: Waxing also stops further ageing, so you can keep the exact colour you like.

lore: {name}: copper that has been out in the weather.
use: Copper turns green over time when exposed to air. An axe scrapes it back, honeycomb stops the process.
secret: Lightning strikes can scrape off the oxidation.

lore: {name}: a metal that never stops changing.
use: Craft from copper ingots. Conducts lightning, ages through four stages and can be waxed.
secret: Copper bulbs flip on and off with each redstone pulse and remember their state.

lore: {name}: a reef you can pick up.
use: Place it near water and it stays alive; dead versions are grey. Silk Touch keeps live coral.
secret: Coral dies in a few seconds when away from water, even a block away.

lore: {name}: a quiet garden at the bottom of the sea.
use: Decorative sea plant. Needs water to stay alive; Silk Touch is needed to keep it.
secret: Coral fans can sit on walls as well as on the ground.

lore: {name}: a promise of treasure, drawn by someone who has been there.
use: Found in cartographer trades and chests. Hold it to read; it shows the way to its goal, marked on the map. Needs a compass heading from the cartographer.
secret: An explorer map is a special filled map; copy it in a cartography table to share the trail.

lore: {name}: a pocket pond with a passenger.
use: Use a water bucket on the creature to catch it; place the bucket on water to release it again.
secret: Mobs kept in a bucket remember their kind and colour when released.

lore: {name}: it rolls where the rail goes.
use: Place it on rails and ride it, or let it carry cargo. The variants carry chests, furnaces, hoppers, TNT or command blocks.
secret: Powered rails speed it up, detector rails sense it passing.

lore: {name}: stone with a promise in it.
use: Mine with the right pickaxe; Fortune gives more drops for most ores, Silk Touch keeps the block. Smelting the raw material gives ingots.
secret: Ore veins are bigger deep down; diamonds like depth most.

lore: {name}: ore, but ready for the fire.
use: Dropped by mining ores. Smelt in a furnace or blast furnace for ingots. Nine make a raw block.
secret: Raw blocks store them compactly and turn back into nine items.

lore: {name}: a bar that has seen fire.
use: Smelted from raw metal or crafted from nuggets. Nine make a block; used for tools, armor and many recipes.
secret: Craft nine nuggets into one ingot and one ingot back into nine nuggets.

lore: {name}: a crumb of metal.
use: Nine make an ingot. Dropped by some mobs and used in a few small recipes.
secret: Nuggets are what zombified piglins drop when they die.

lore: {name}: a small thing that insists on being pretty.
use: Bone meal spreads it; craft it into dye or use as decoration. Bees pollinate flowers and grow crops.
secret: Dandelions and poppies become the dyes yellow and red.

lore: {name}: hunger's answer.
use: Eat it to restore hunger and saturation. Cooked meat restores much more than raw.
secret: A full hunger bar does not stop you eating a cake: you can always eat food that has a special effect.

lore: {name}: it wants a fire before a plate.
use: Eat for a little hunger; cook it in a furnace, smoker or campfire for more. Some give bad effects.
secret: Smokers and campfires cook it faster than a furnace for meat.

lore: {name}: a handful of patience.
use: Plant on farmland (or the right ground) with water nearby, and wait. Bone meal speeds growth.
secret: Chickens follow a player holding wheat seeds.

lore: {name}: a crystal still on its way.
use: Grows on budding amethyst in stages; Silk Touch keeps small buds, a pickaxe breaks clusters into shards.
secret: Fortune gives more shards from a cluster.

lore: {name}: light that a frog ate and returned.
use: Dropped when a frog eats a small magma cube; the colour depends on the frog's biome. A bright light block.
secret: Place it to light a build with soft colours; it shines at light level 15.

lore: {name}: a block that speaks in commands.
use: Creative-only. Holds a command that runs when it gets a signal. Repeating blocks run every tick, chain blocks follow a command block.
secret: Only operators in creative mode can place or edit it.

lore: {name}: a trophy of something that once looked back.
use: Wear it on your head or place it on the ground or a wall. Note blocks play the sound of the mob below it.
secret: Charged creepers' explosions are the only way to drop most mob heads.

lore: {name}: a plain promise of a chick.
use: Throw it for a chance of a chick; use it to breed chickens, or craft it into cakes.
secret: A thrown egg has a 1 in 8 chance of a chick, and rarely four.

lore: {name}: stone that pretends, and bites.
use: Looks like an ordinary block, but a silverfish hides inside and bursts out when it is mined. Found in strongholds and mountains.
secret: Silk Touch keeps the block without releasing the silverfish.

lore: {name}: stone that someone took the time to smooth.
use: Crafted from four blocks of the rough stone, or cut in a stonecutter. A common building block.
secret: Polished versions make stairs, slabs and walls too.

lore: {name}: stone with a pattern cut into it.
use: Crafted from slabs or cut in a stonecutter. A decorative block with a carved face.
secret: Chiseled bookshelves can hold six books and give redstone signals.

lore: {name}: a block that started to give up.
use: Smelt the normal bricks to get the cracked version. A decorative variant.
secret: Cracked bricks are also what ruins and fortresses generate for an old look.

lore: {name}: a surface with no opinions.
use: Smelt the normal block to smooth it. Flat and clean for floors and builds.
secret: Smooth stone slabs make a good floor for redstone builds.

lore: {name}: a pale mineral with a sharp smell.
use: Mined with a pickaxe; used for the sulfur stones, the sulfur cube and decoration.
secret: It comes from the sulfur caves.

lore: {name}: a red mineral that stains the fingers.
use: Mined with a pickaxe; used for building and decoration in the new caves.
secret: It comes with its own bricks and polished forms.

lore: {name}: amber from the creaking's tree.
use: Resin clumps come from creaking hearts and resin blocks; smelt a clump for a resin brick. Used for blocks and as a trim material.
secret: Resin brick is a trim material too.

lore: {name}: the Nether's way of having a garden.
use: Grows in the Nether's forests; bone meal on a fungus grows a huge fungus, on nylium it spreads roots. Shears harvest vines.
secret: Vines can be climbed, and weeping vines hang from the Nether's ceilings.

lore: {name}: green, quiet and always growing.
use: Breaks instantly by hand. Shears keep it; some drop seeds or can be bone-mealed to spread.
secret: Many of these plants only grow where the light and ground fit.

lore: {name}: the ground, in one of its moods.
use: Dug with a shovel. Different soils decide what can grow on them and how they feel underfoot.
secret: Moss and mud change which plants grow in a garden.

lore: {name}: the world's own bones.
use: Mined with a pickaxe. Used in building and as a base for crafting. Smelt or cut for variants.
secret: Some of these stones are only found in one biome or one dimension.

lore: {name}: stone, cut to a plan.
use: Crafted or cut from the matching block or ingot. A building block with stairs, slabs and walls in many cases.
secret: Stonecutters turn them into stairs and slabs more cheaply.

lore: {name}: a whole store of value in one cube.
use: Crafted from nine items and crafted back into nine. A compact store and a decorative block.
secret: Beacons use iron, gold, emerald, diamond and netherite blocks as their base.
